input: AuthorTide Submission Accord is intended to record proposed manuscript authorship, contributor responses, readiness, integrity concerns, and authorized external submission while preserving an unresolved approval rule. Research Leads record manuscript readiness. Publication Coordinators record external submissions only after submission authorization is present. Whether submission may proceed without approval from an unavailable Contributor is unresolved, and the roles that classify Contributors as unavailable and grant authorization when a concern exists are undecided.
